공무원.x: My dream is to become a civil servant.
공무원.e: -원 = staff member: 공무원, 은행원, 회사원, 직원.
공무원.t: Government jobs are very popular in Korea for stability; people study for the 공무원 시험 for years.

특별하다.m: to be special, to be particular
특별하다.x: Today is my birthday, so it's a special day.

신분증.ex: 은행에 갈 때 신분증을 꼭 가져가세요.
신분증.x: Be sure to bring your ID when you go to the bank.
신분증.e: Literally 'status proof'. -증 = certificate or card: 학생증, 운전면허증.

청년.x: These days it's hard for young people to find jobs.
청년.e: Literally 'green years' — life in its fresh, green stage.
청년.t: 청년 means young adults; for teenagers use 청소년.

낭비.ex: 하루 종일 게임만 하는 건 시간 낭비예요.
낭비.x: Playing games all day is a waste of time.

방해하다.m: to disturb, to interrupt, to get in the way of
방해하다.x: My little brother keeps disturbing my studying.
방해하다.t: 방해하지 마세요 is the common phrase for 'Do not disturb.'

승진하다.m: to be promoted, to get a promotion
승진하다.ex: 우리 형이 올해 드디어 과장으로 승진했어요.
승진하다.x: My older brother finally got promoted to manager this year.
승진하다.e: Literally 'rise and advance' up the ladder.

핵심.ex: 이 글의 핵심은 환경 보호의 중요성이에요.
핵심.x: The key point of this text is the importance of protecting the environment.

끝내.m: in the end, finally; (with a negative) never, after all
끝내.ex: 그는 끝내 아무 말도 하지 않았어요.
끝내.x: In the end, he didn't say a single word.
끝내.e: From 끝 'end' — 'right up to the end'.
끝내.t: Pronounced [끈내] — nasalization; often used with negatives for something that never happened despite waiting.

특허.ex: 그 회사는 새 기술로 특허를 받았어요.
특허.x: That company got a patent for its new technology.
특허.e: Literally 'special permission' — the right to be the only one using an invention.
특허.t: Pronounced [트커]: ㄱ + ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

복구.ex: 홍수 피해를 복구하는 데 한 달이 걸렸어요.
복구.x: It took a month to repair the flood damage.
복구.t: 복구 is for damaged places, systems or data (데이터 복구); recovering health is 회복.

백신.x: I went to the clinic to get a flu shot.
백신.e: From 'vaccine'; the v sound becomes ㅂ in Korean.
백신.t: You 'get' a vaccine with 맞다: 백신을 맞다, not 받다.

정권.ex: 새 정권이 들어선 후 많은 정책이 바뀌었어요.
정권.x: Many policies changed after the new administration took power.
정권.t: Pronounced [정꿘]; 정권 교체 means 'a change of government'.

극히.x: Cases like this are extremely rare.
극히.e: Sino syllable 'extreme, pole' plus adverb ending -히.
극히.t: Pronounced [그키] — ㄱ and ㅎ merge into ㅋ.

따라잡다.x: I studied hard and caught up with my classmates.
따라잡다.e: 따라 'following' + 잡다 'to catch': follow and catch.

식은 죽 먹기.forms: 식은 죽 먹기예요 / N은/는 식은 죽 먹기
식은 죽 먹기.m: a piece of cake, a breeze
식은 죽 먹기.ex: 한국 요리는 저한테 식은 죽 먹기예요.
식은 죽 먹기.x: Cooking Korean food is a piece of cake for me.
식은 죽 먹기.e: Literally 'eating porridge that has cooled'—no burning, no waiting.
nb: 발 없는 말이 천 리 간다

평수.m: floor area (in pyeong), size of a home
평수.e: Literally 'number of pyeong': a home's size.

역전.m: comeback, reversal (taking the lead from behind)
역전.x: They made a dramatic comeback in the last minute.
역전.t: Pronounced [역쩐]; 역전승 is a comeback win and 역전패 a loss after leading.

형벌.ex: 그 범죄에 대한 형벌이 너무 가볍다는 의견이 많아요.
형벌.x: Many people think the punishment for that crime is too light.

청빈하다.m: honorably poor, living in honest poverty
청빈하다.x: That scholar lived in honest poverty all his life.
청빈하다.e: Literally 'clean and poor' — poor because honest, a Confucian ideal.

언뜻.forms: 언뜻 보다 · 언뜻 보기에 'at first glance' · 언뜻 떠오르다
언뜻.m: at a glance, briefly; at first glance
언뜻.ex: 언뜻 보면 두 사람은 쌍둥이 같아요.
언뜻.x: At first glance, the two of them look like twins.
언뜻.t: 언뜻 보기에 means 'at first glance' and is often followed by a contrast.

울며 겨자 먹기.forms: 울며 겨자 먹기로 + verb · 울며 겨자 먹기예요
울며 겨자 먹기.m: doing something against one's will; having no choice but to do it
울며 겨자 먹기.ex: 회사가 멀어서 울며 겨자 먹기로 비싼 택시를 탔어요.
울며 겨자 먹기.x: The office was far, so I had no choice but to take an expensive taxi.
울며 겨자 먹기.e: Literally 'eating mustard while crying' — doing something unpleasant because you must.
울며 겨자 먹기.t: Most often used as an adverb phrase: 울며 겨자 먹기로 + verb.
nb: 개구리 올챙이 적 생각 못 한다

국가부채.ex: 고령화로 국가부채가 빠르게 늘어날 것으로 보입니다.
국가부채.x: National debt is expected to grow quickly due to population aging.
국가부채.t: Everyday speech often says 나랏빚 'the country's debt'; 국가부채 is the news and policy term.

선비정신.m: the scholar's spirit (integrity, frugality and principle of Joseon scholars)
선비정신.ex: 그는 가난해도 정직하게 사는 선비정신을 지켰어요.
선비정신.x: He kept the scholar's spirit of living honestly even in poverty.

방어기제.x: Brushing things off with jokes is also a kind of defense mechanism.

전기장.x: An electric field forms around an electric charge.
전기장.e: Literally 'electricity field'. -장 = field: 자기장, 전기장, 중력장.

호환성.ex: 이 프로그램은 구형 컴퓨터와 호환성이 떨어져요.
호환성.x: This program has poor compatibility with older computers.
호환성.t: Pronounced [호환썽]; say 호환성이 좋다/떨어지다 for good or poor compatibility.

적조.ex: 적조 때문에 양식장 물고기들이 떼죽음을 당했습니다.
적조.x: Fish at the fish farm died en masse because of the red tide.
적조.e: Literally 'red tide', just like the English term.
적조.t: Pronounced [적쪼]: ㅈ after ㄱ becomes tense.

고유성.ex: 각 지역 문화의 고유성을 지켜야 합니다.
고유성.x: We must preserve the unique character of each regional culture.

비분강개.x: Filled with grief and outrage, independence activists sought to regain the country.
비분강개.e: Literally 'sorrow and anger, indignation and lament' over injustice.
